pages.text: An INCLUDE line loads a library.$(br2)A LABEL with the library name follows the block, like $(1)c0de/math$(). INCLUDE lines start at x=5, right after the NOOP in line 1. They come before all structs, variables, constants and functions.
Craft a NOOP block and an empty map together.
Now the program can call functions like $(1)c0de/math/ROUND$().
